Name: Improved Fish Shop
Author: arthursmarthur
Description:
I added five new items to the Fish Shop.

[b]Seaweed[/b]: 25g, available stock is 5. 
[b]Green Algae[/b]: 20g, available stock is 5. 
[b]White Algae[/b]: 30g, available stock is 5.
[b]Recycling Machine[/b]: 1000g
[b]Carp Surprise[/b]: 300g, available stock is 3. 

[b]FUTURE PLANS[/b]

Add Worm Bin that costs 2,500g (Possibly more, as bait is pretty useful).
Add Baked Fish that costs 200g (available stock being 3). It will only be available in spring and summer.
Add Dish O' the Sea that costs 600g. (available stock being 2). It will only be available in Fall.
Add Sea Foam Pudding that costs 1000g (available stock being 2). It will only be available in Winter.
